title: The Podcast Code and the Next Shipment
lessons: A podcast host says they use AG1 every morning, then gives listeners a personal code and offer.
The player already subscribes to AG1 and sees that the next pouch is scheduled to ship before the current one is finished.

text: A podcast host says they use AG1 every morning, then gives listeners a personal code and offer.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: There you are again.

entry-first-2.speaker: AG1
text: Podcast?

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Podcast.

entry-first-4.speaker: AG1
text: The host talks about using me, then gives you a code. The code is the part that makes the sponsorship impossible to miss.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: Even if they actually drink you every morning?

entry-first-6.speaker: AG1
text: They can mean it and still be paid. Those things can happen at the same time.

choice-first.speaker: AG1
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I trust the host enough to listen.
I want to know where the recommendation ends and the sponsorship starts.
I do not want breakfast advice from a podcast ad.

first-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then the host got me a fair hearing. I still have to earn what happens after that.

first-2.speaker: AG1
text: Good question. Treat the code as the cleanest clue that you are still inside the sponsorship.

first-3.speaker: AG1
text: Then skip the code and finish your coffee.

first-3-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Happily.
The player already subscribes to AG1 and sees that the next pouch is scheduled to ship before the current one is finished.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Why are you shipping again? I still have half a pouch.

entry-return-2.speaker: AG1
text: Because your subscription is still set to every thirty days.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Can I move it?

entry-return-4.speaker: AG1
text: Yes. Push the date back, change the cadence, or cancel in the member portal.

entry-return-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: That answer was suspiciously painless.

entry-return-6.speaker: AG1
text: I would like to keep you. I do not need to trap you.

choice-return.speaker: AG1
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like being able to push the shipment back.
So if I do nothing, you just keep sending it every month.
I do not want my vitamins on auto-renew.

return-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then make the schedule match how fast you actually use it.

return-2.speaker: AG1
text: Yes. If you do nothing, the thirty-day cadence keeps going.

return-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: That is the part I wanted said out loud.

return-2-2.speaker: AG1
text: Fair.

return-3.speaker: AG1
text: Then a one-time purchase makes more sense for you. I am still a subscription if you choose the subscription.
